# jamfplatform_pro_licensed_software (List Resource)

Lists Jamf Pro licensed software records. Supply an optional case-insensitive `name_substring` filter applied locally after the full list is fetched. List entries surface as identity-only (id and display name); full detail requires a per-record read.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List every licensed software record in the tenant, optionally filtered by a
# case-insensitive name substring. List entries surface as identity-only (id and
# display name); full detail requires a per-record read.
list "jamfplatform_pro_licensed_software" "all" {
  provider = jamfplatform

  config {
    filter = {
      name_substring = "Acme"
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (Attributes) Optional case-insensitive `name_substring` filter applied client-side after the full list is fetched. For exact-name lookup, use the singular `by name` data source instead. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filter))
